items.title: 67848_Jimmy McPartland oral history interview
items.q: And we accompanied him with the band you know, came in on his finales and so forth.

ctx.x: That's right. (LAUGHTER). Dressed up fit to kill and Bobby Short, he was about eleven, twelve years old. And he played the heck out of that piano at that time. And we accompanied him with the band you know, came in on his finales and so forth.
Listen, I'll have to go back to 'Black and White Baby' (LAUGHTER) and see what he says about you. (LAUGHTER).
